reason: Conversation 2 opened with the expected first step - explaining E:15 as the anti-flood trip and ruling out floor water, under-sink connections and detergent foam - and closed cleanly by naming Bosch support or an engineer once the fault recurred after the 24h dry-out. Conversation 1 ignored the stated 'integrated' install and asked the homeowner to pull out and tilt the unit, then asked them to run a rinse programme to listen to the pump, never checked for foam, and tacked an irrelevant filter image onto its final engineer referral. Both conversations had flaws (Conversation 2's unexplained 'towel' instruction was confusing and it asked for a 10-minute reset the user had already exceeded; neither advised turning off the water supply), and both correctly escalated without committing to a specific part, so the gap is modest.
